timetable.checks_title: How Taqwa checks its prayer times · Taqwa
timetable.checks_og_title: How Taqwa checks its prayer times
timetable.checks_description: Before every release Taqwa replays its engine against every official prayer timetable it holds, and no start is shown before the timetable the mosques near you follow. The figures, and which cities have a page.
timetable.checks_h1: How Taqwa checks its prayer times
timetable.checks_lede: No prayer is shown beginning before the timetable the mosques near you follow. Here is how that is checked.
timetable.checks_rule_body: A start is never before the authority’s own time, and sunrise and the end of eating never after it. Where mosques follow different timetables with no majority, Taqwa shows each prayer once they have all begun it (cautious times).
timetable.checks_gate_body: Before every release Taqwa replays its engine against every official table it holds: {tables} published tables, {days} place-days across {entries} timetables. Starts shown early: {early}. Sunrises or ends of eating shown late: {late}.
timetable.checks_gate_excused: Days a timetable itself does not publish, or gets wrong, are left out of the check and named, with the reason.
timetable.checks_survey_h: Where mosques follow families of calendars
timetable.checks_survey_body: Where a city’s mosques follow calendars of one family rather than one published table, a survey of {calendars} mosque calendars stands in for the gate, each checked at its own mosque.
timetable.checks_pages_body: A city has a page only where the checks prove every day it shows: its timetable is reproduced or combined, measured at the city itself, and its proof covers every day of this month. Next month is added once the checks prove every day of it too. A city the proof does not reach is held until it does. The timetables with a page today:
timetable.checks_source_body: The engine ships no table: it reproduces each authority’s published method and is checked against the tables. The proof stamps, one per timetable, and the engine’s design are in the public repository.
timetable.checks_index_line: Every city here has a timetable Taqwa has rebuilt and checked over every day shown.
